يأتلق (form VIII)

# يَأْتَلِقَ (yaʔtaliqa) /jaʔ.ta.li.qa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِئْتَلَقَ (iʔtalaqa)
# يَأْتَلِقْ (yaʔtaliq) /jaʔ.ta.liq/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِئْتَلَقَ (iʔtalaqa)
